candidate_knowledge.problem: Sparse straight marks on a near-uniform countertop
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: Guidance identifies insufficient broad flowing variation; checkpoint code uses white-stone and separate rods.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Uniform material and isolated rods may not represent continuous surface variation; lighting could suppress contrast.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Compared generated-coordinate image color, directional noise color, and noise-driven roughness with fixed camera and two softbox positions; retained generated image on the real counter mesh.
candidate_knowledge.applicability: Countertop-specific scene study; cross-scene transfer untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Six full-frame student-visible render reads and selection; no detailed comparative assessment recorded.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Image is an external dependency; projection stretching and effects of altered lighting not separately assessed.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: Actual reference material, objective improvement, edge behavior, final render inspection, and modified procedural distortion.

limitations: Reference geometry and material ground truth are unavailable; reference streaks may contain lighting effects.
Evaluator-produced scene states and target geometry establish scene facts only and do not demonstrate student discovery or checks.
Generated image is a local texture on the modeled counter, not evidence of a full-reference image-plane shortcut.
The saved shader uses Generated coordinates despite its world-space comment; the separate XYZ node is not used to drive the texture.
The image selection is observable, but its precise visual rationale and success are unknown.
